results.text: A shopper with valid credentials lands on the product list.
results.detail: After logging in with valid credentials, being on the /inventory.html URL with all six products shown proves the shopper landed on the product list.

results.text: A locked-out shopper sees an error saying the account is locked out.
results.detail: The error element is read directly after the locked-out login attempt and must state that the account is locked out.

results.text: Sorting by price low to high puts products in ascending price order.
results.detail: After selecting low to high, the displayed prices are checked for ascending order across all six products, so the check cannot pass on an empty list.

results.text: The cart badge shows the number of items added to the cart.
results.detail: After two different items are added, the badge must show 2, which proves it counts the items rather than only indicating a non-empty cart.

results.text: Checkout does not continue without a postal code and tells the shopper it is required.
results.detail: With only the postal code missing, remaining on checkout step one proves checkout did not continue and the error text proves the shopper is told it is required.

results.text: The order total equals the item total plus tax.
results.detail: On the order overview for a two-item order, the check directly compares the displayed total with the displayed item total plus tax.

results.text: The demo account problem_user sees a different image for each product.
results.detail: each product should have its own image; observed ["sl-404-Cq1a9k9X.jpg","sl-404-Cq1a9k9X.jpg","sl-404-Cq1a9k9X.jpg","sl-404-Cq1a9k9X.jpg","sl-404-Cq1a9k9X.jpg","sl-404-Cq1a9k9X.jpg"]

results.text: The shopper receives an order confirmation email after checkout.
results.detail: The available tools only observe the website and cannot see an email inbox, and the on-screen confirmation would not prove that an email was received.

results.text: A signed-in store manager can open the refunds page. (Manager credentials have not been provided.)
results.detail: Store manager credentials have not been provided, so a signed-in manager session cannot be established to test access to the refunds page.
